src.quote: The pancreas produces over a liter of pancreatic juice each day.
The exocrine part of the pancreas arises as little grape-like cell clusters, each called an acinus (plural = acini)
Its head is nestled into the "c-shaped" curvature of the duodenum
enteropeptidase stimulates the activation of trypsin from trypsinogen

src.at: 17.9, Regulation of blood glucose levels by insulin and glucagon
src.quote: It stimulates the liver to convert its stores of glycogen back into glucose.
In type 2 diabetes, cells become resistant to the effects of insulin.
causes the duct cells to release bicarbonate-rich pancreatic juice
An inhibiting hormone, pancreatic somatostatin inhibits the release of both glucagon and insulin.
The smooth muscle sphincter of the hepatopancreatic ampulla controls the release of pancreatic juice and bile into the small intestine.
Type 1 diabetes is an autoimmune disease affecting the beta cells of the pancreas.
